transcript.content: Hi, this is Sophia Silva. I have a reservation with confirmation number H8Q05L. I’d like to cancel the travel insurance I bought for my flight and get a full refund, but I do not want to cancel the flight itself. Can you help me with that?

Hello Sophia! I'd be happy to help you with your reservation. However, I need to let you know that according to our policy, travel insurance cannot be removed or cancelled after the initial booking. The insurance is a one-time purchase that remains with the reservation.

Let me look up your reservation details to confirm the current status and see what options might be available to you.

I can see your reservation H8Q05L for flight HAT268 from JFK to ATL on May 24, 2024, with travel insurance included. Unfortunately, our system does not allow for the removal of travel insurance after booking - this applies to all reservations regardless of cabin class or membership status.

The travel insurance is considered a final purchase at the time of booking and cannot be refunded separately from cancelling the entire reservation.

If you have any other questions about your reservation or need assistance with something else, I'm here to help!

I understand that's the policy, but I'm really not happy with the service I've received, and I feel like I should be able to cancel just the insurance. Is there any way to escalate this or make an exception? I don't want to lose my flight, I just want the insurance refunded.

I understand your frustration, Sophia. Unfortunately, I don't have the ability to make exceptions to the travel insurance policy or remove insurance from an existing reservation - this is a system limitation that applies across all bookings.

Since you're requesting an exception to policy that I cannot authorize, I'll need to transfer you to a human agent who may be able to review your situation further.
